title: Effectiveness of Counter-Speech against Abusive Content: A Multidimensional Annotation and Classification Study

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the effectiveness of counter-speech interventions against Islamophobic hate speech by annotating and classifying responses across six dimensions (Clarity, Evidence, Emotional Appeal, Rebuttal, Audience Adaptation, and Fairness) using BERT-based models on the CONAN dataset.
